_comment: Map profile. build-save.js --map merchant-quarter. One of these per base map; everything map-specific lives here.

board._comment: Where the physical board sits in TTS units (1 unit = 1 inch). The Mirrored City battlefield frame is centred here. tableScale enlarges the named table furniture about its own origin so seats and card rows fit beyond the board.

tableTop._comment: The Kraken table has a glass top; this opaque slab is the playing surface. Centred on the table (not the board). Set to null to skip.

lighting._comment: Overrides the base save's scene lighting (Merchant Quarter ships a dim purple night). Values as in Options > Lighting. Delete this block to keep the base lighting.

battlefield._comment: Rulebook p.9: typically 30 x 44 inches. Frame drawn on the board; cards spawn outside it, models inside.

ground._comment: Textured tile laid over the board under the terrain. imageFile is relative to tts/ and becomes a file:// URL (local only; upload it to Steam Cloud and switch to imageUrl before publishing). A Custom_Tile is 2 units deep at scale 1 and its width follows the image aspect, so the build reads the image size to get the scale right; for a remote imageUrl give imageAspect (width / height). Set to null for none.

keep._comment: What survives from the base save. Terrain = Custom_Model / Custom_Assetbundle inside playBox and above the table. Everything else is dropped unless listed.

dropGuids._comment: Terrain whose mesh or texture no longer exists online (pastebin / dead CDN files). They would show as blank models and load errors.

stripUrlPatterns._comment: Any object whose mesh, bundle or image URL contains one of these is dropped; attached child objects and decals that match are removed from the objects that carry them.

spawn._comment: Each player's staging zone lies beyond their long edge of the board (board.depthZ / 2 from centre), as wide as the board. Cards fill the rows nearest the board, models the rows behind them, all measured outward from the board edge. Injected into Global.lua as SPAWN; the build draws the zone from it.

extras._comment: Mirrored City table furniture in the strip right of the board: status token dispensers, Tempo / VP counters per seat, and the quick-reference slab. Token text and reference text live in Global.lua.

dice._comment: Where the two D6 cups kept from the base map go.

tokens._comment: readFrom east: the grid runs along the table edge and the labels read from the east, the same for both players. x0/z0 is the first token (reader's top-left).
tokens.label: TOKENS

tracker._comment: Clickable tracker board right of the board, read from the east edge. Rows run along z (rowLength), stacked toward the east (rowsDepth). Each row is a track of numbered buttons; clicking one sets the value and the table script remembers it. Like the rulebook's Playboard: shared Round track, Tempo and Victory Points per seat.

rulebook._comment: The rulebook PDF (not in the repo; rights unconfirmed). The build copies it to tts/assets/local (gitignored, no spaces in the path: TTS does not decode %20 in file URLs) and places it as a readable book object.

seats._comment: Player hand zones along the long table edges. widthX / depthZ in inches.

stations._comment: The free table strip left of the board holds the List Importer: an outline, a label and a button pad (GM Notes MC_STATION_IMPORT). Table edge is near x -65 after tableScale.
